build_mujoco_stub_package: build a doc-only mujoco stub package for Sphinx autodoc by running the script with an output directory
run_make_mujoco_stubs_cli: run the make_mujoco_stubs CLI to generate a pip-installable pure-Python mujoco stub package
read_mujoco_version: read the mujoco version string from python/pyproject.toml in the repository root
parse_mujoco_constants: parse numeric #define constants from MuJoCo C header files in the include/mujoco directory
generate_mujoco_init_py: generate a mujoco __init__.py with inlined constants, enums, and mock stub types for autodoc
